stories.title: Heavily‑armed police begin patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach shooting
stories.summary: Heavily‑armed officers from the New South Wales Armed Response Command have started patrolling Sydney’s busy tourist precincts, major events and places of worship, carrying long‑arm rifles. The deployment follows the December 2023 Bondi Beach shooting in which two gunmen killed fifteen people, including a ten‑year‑old girl, during a Hanukkah gathering. Police say the patrols aim to prevent, deter and quickly respond to serious threats such as active‑shooter incidents.
stories.why: It demonstrates the government’s direct response to Australia’s worst mass shooting in decades and the heightened focus on preventing hate‑motivated violence.

stories.title: Carlsberg files DRHP, Pernod Ricard and Coca‑Cola explore India IPOs
stories.summary: Carlsberg has filed an updated draft red‑herring prospectus for a potential IPO in India. Pernod Ricard is preparing a proposed listing of its Indian business and is awaiting board approval. Coca‑Cola is assessing a possible IPO of its Indian bottling operations, citing the market’s value.
stories.why: The moves show growing interest from multinational beverage firms in using Indian public markets to raise capital and expand their presence.
